results.instruction: Stop the car on a firm level surface away from traffic and set up a warning triangle.
Apply the parking brake, switch off the ignition, and ensure all passengers exit the vehicle.
Retrieve the spare wheel and tools, including the jack and wrench, from the trunk.
Use the provided tool to remove the hubcap if the wheel has one.
Use the wrench to loosen the wheel nuts one half to one turn before jacking up the vehicle.
